buttons.iconNote: Always with a translated aria-label: the icon has no visible text.

color.contrast: Contrast checked: text ≥4.5:1 and UI parts ≥3:1 on the surfaces. The axe sweep verifies every page and state.

color.title: Color

containers.dialogBody: You have unsaved changes to the tutor settings. If you leave now, they will be lost.
containers.dialogNote: Pages use <dialog data-modal> with showModal(): it traps focus, closes with Esc and returns focus to its opener.
containers.title: Cards, dialogs and toasts

focus.ringBody: A 2 px outline in --color-focus with a 2 px offset, on focus-visible only. Contrast ≥3:1 against its surroundings.
focus.title: Focus and motion

forms.emailHelp: Use the email your school gave you.
forms.lead: Every field has a visible label. Help and errors are linked with aria-describedby; an error adds aria-invalid and an icon, not just color.
forms.radio1Help: The tutor may give the full solution when asked.
forms.radio2Help: The tutor gives hints and shows the solution only at the end.
forms.radio3Help: The tutor never gives the full solution.
forms.textareaHelp: Write each step on its own line.
forms.title: Forms

global.imfaheNote: The official IMFAHE logo is pending; this placeholder is shown until it arrives. The logo is not recreated or traced.
global.langNote: Switches the whole page, including sample content. Language names always appear in their own language.

guided.lead: Guided-mode indicator with a hint counter (S3).

icons.lead: Lucide (ISC license), copied unmodified into assets/img/icons.svg. Decorative icons get aria-hidden; meaningful ones get a translated aria-label.
icons.title: Icons

ds.lead: Tokens and components shared by the prototype and the future React app. Names match the @theme variables and the React components one to one (Constitution IV).

motion.body: 150 ms color transitions with --ease-standard, always behind motion-safe:. With reduced motion there is no animation, and loading states advance at once.
motion.title: Motion

spacing.lead: A single 4 px base unit (--spacing). p-4 is 16 px.
spacing.title: Spacing
